nodes.label: Auto-Clarity rule (commit)
nodes.rationale: Always include a body for breaking changes, security fixes, data migrations, and reverts because future debuggers need the context — terse subject-only commits would hide the why.

nodes.label: Snyk High Risk rating (false positive)
nodes.rationale: Static analysis flags subprocess use (fixed arg list, no shell interpolation, file content via stdin) and file read/write scoped to the user-specified target plus an out-of-tree backup dir; skill never executes file content as code or reaches outside that path, so the rating is a false positive, not an actual vulnerability.

nodes.label: Auto-Clarity rule (review)
nodes.rationale: Drop terse mode for CVE-class security findings, architectural disagreements, and onboarding contexts because the author needs full explanation/rationale, not a one-liner; resume terse afterward.

nodes.label: Auto-Clarity rule (caveman core)
nodes.rationale: Drop caveman compression for security warnings, irreversible-action confirmations, and multi-step sequences where omitted articles/conjunctions risk misread, since compression-induced ambiguity is worse than the tokens saved.

nodes.label: "Unit Tests for English" principle
nodes.rationale: Checklists must validate requirements quality (completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability) rather than test implementation behavior, so ambiguity is caught in the spec before code is written, not after.

nodes.label: Turborepo Monorepo Tool
nodes.rationale: Provides build caching and incremental builds; constitution already specifies Turborepo; chosen over Nx (too complex), Lerna (unmaintained), Rush (enterprise overkill).

nodes.label: pnpm Workspaces
nodes.rationale: Strict dependency resolution avoids phantom dependencies, efficient disk usage via content-addressable storage, native workspace support with Turborepo, faster installs than npm/yarn.

nodes.label: Single Go Module with Internal Packages
nodes.rationale: Simpler dependency management with one go.mod; internal packages enforce encapsulation; easier to extract modules later than multi-module or go.work approaches.
nodes.norm_label: single go module with internal packages

nodes.label: Shared Base tsconfig Strategy
nodes.rationale: Consistent TypeScript settings across packages with per-package overrides (React Native vs Web); enables project references for faster incremental builds.

nodes.label: Single docker-compose.yml for Local Services (001)
nodes.rationale: One-command startup for all dependencies (PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, MinIO); consistent environment across developer machines; easy to add/remove services.

nodes.label: Husky + lint-staged Pre-commit Hooks
nodes.rationale: Industry standard for JS/TS, works with pnpm workspaces, runs different checks per file type; chosen over pre-commit (needs Python) and lefthook (less ecosystem support).

nodes.label: Prettier + ESLint + golangci-lint
nodes.rationale: Prettier avoids formatting debates; ESLint enforces code quality rules; golangci-lint bundles multiple Go linters.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions Initial CI Setup
nodes.rationale: Constitution specifies GitHub Actions; free tier sufficient for initial development; initial workflow lints, builds, tests, and caches pnpm/Turborepo artifacts.

nodes.label: Native Docker Health Check Strategy
nodes.rationale: Built-in health check commands integrate with depends_on condition:service_healthy; no external dependencies required; standard across orchestration platforms.

nodes.label: Named Volume Data Persistence Strategy
nodes.rationale: Named volumes survive container removal, are easy to inspect/backup, and cleanly separate data from containers; bind mounts rejected for platform-specific path/permission issues.

nodes.label: docker- Prefixed Makefile Target Naming
nodes.rationale: Clear namespace prevents conflicts, consistent with 001-init-monorepo patterns, self-documenting via `make help`.

nodes.label: Standard Service Port Configuration
nodes.rationale: Standard ports (5432/6379/9000/9001) are expected by tools/libraries and match production conventions.

nodes.label: Pre-flight Checks in Makefile
nodes.rationale: Better developer experience with clear error messages for Docker-not-running, port-in-use, and low-disk-space, preventing cryptic native Docker errors.

nodes.label: Simple Development Credentials
nodes.rationale: Easy to type/remember, clearly marked dev-only; production instead uses AWS SSM Parameter Store for secrets.

nodes.label: Multi-layer CI Caching Strategy
nodes.rationale: pnpm store + Go modules + Turborepo cache avoid re-downloading packages and enable incremental builds across PRs; expected hit rate >80-90%.

nodes.label: 80% Code Coverage Threshold
nodes.rationale: Native coverage tools (vitest, go test) with a simple in-workflow threshold check avoid external services like Codecov or SonarQube.

nodes.label: CI Concurrency Cancellation Strategy
nodes.rationale: Cancel in-progress runs on the same PR to save CI minutes while never cancelling main branch runs; different PRs run independently.

nodes.label: Authentication Module
nodes.rationale: Gateway to all features; no system functionality is accessible without authentication (US1 priority rationale).

nodes.label: Type Definitions
nodes.rationale: Type consistency across frontend and backend prevents bugs and improves developer experience (US3 rationale).

nodes.label: Orders Module
nodes.rationale: Order taking is the core function of the restaurant POS system (US1 rationale).

nodes.label: StockAlert
nodes.rationale: Proactive alerts prevent menu items from becoming unavailable during service (US3 priority rationale).

nodes.label: Billing Module
nodes.rationale: Invoice generation is legally required in Costa Rica and most jurisdictions; non-compliant invoices risk fines and legal issues.

nodes.label: FiscalSubmission
nodes.rationale: Costa Rica Ministerio de Hacienda electronic invoicing (FE) compliance drives fiscal submission and offline retry design.
